## Contents

- [**Day 1**](day1.qmd) — full conference notes, talk by talk
- [**Day 2**](day2.qmd) — still filling in as the conference progresses
- [**Knowledge**](knowledge.qmd) — clean-markdown copies of every URL referenced in the day notes

## About these notes

::: {.callout-note}
## How these notes get written
The day notes are AI-assisted: Claude Code drafts and organizes each talk's notes from the raw session transcript and referenced URLs, then structures them into subsections/callouts. An `AGENTS.md` file in the repo acts as the persistent context — conventions for structure, conciseness, and styling — so the drafting stays consistent across separate sessions instead of depending on chat history.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Transcripts aren't perfect
Session transcripts come from auto-generated captions, not a human. Names, jargon, and numbers can get misheard — see each day page's disclaimer, and treat anything surprising as worth double-checking against the original talk.
:::

Source and setup: [github.com/parmsam/posit-conf-2026-notes](https://github.com/parmsam/posit-conf-2026-notes)
